pictures.observations: Elevated side view: five clustered unequal square towers with tall gray pointed roofs, repeated belfry/window bands, semicircular transept end with stepped conical roofs, lower long western nave and taller eastern Gothic choir.

Side overview confirms five towers, paired flank towers around central crossing, semicircular multi-storey transept, lower western nave with tiled chapel roofs, taller choir with tall pointed glazing and flying buttresses, and lower eastern rounded chapels. Fine sculpture/tracery and portal design are approximate; no full west-facade view inspected.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful photographs plus standard viewer Protomaps/Mapzen PMTiles, no bespoke sources or photo redistribution.
